environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed with a Function URL where the AuthType property is set to AWS_IAM. The resource-based policy on the Lambda function grants lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl permission only to principal 'arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/FrontendServiceRole' with a condition key 'lambda:FunctionUrlAuthType' set to 'AWS_IAM'. The companion frontend (app.example.com) runs on an ECS Fargate task assuming FrontendServiceRole and proxies authenticated user requests to the Lambda function URL by signing them with SigV4. Browser clients never call the Lambda function URL directly — they call the frontend's /api/* endpoints which then invoke the Lambda. The function URL endpoint itself is not exposed in any DNS record or frontend JavaScript. Session cookies are set with SameSite=Strict and are only sent to the frontend origin.
